description: XM Cyber Exposure Management Platform is a software designed to continuously identify, analyze, and prioritize security risks within enterprise environments. It models potential attack paths across hybrid networks, highlighting vulnerabilities and misconfigurations that could beexploited by threats. The software integrates data from multiple security tools to provide actionable insights, focusing remediation efforts on issues that pose the highest risk to critical assets. XM Cyber Exposure Management Platform aims to improve the efficiency of security operations by automating risk prioritization and streamlining incident response processes, helping organizations to mitigate threats before they can impact business operations.
